description: Update one gi sponsor placement (by slot from mu_gi_logos) — swap its logo_url, set its status (ok|low|request|missing) and/or add a note (e.g. where the vector was requested). Owner-only.

consent.description: Written permission to embroider this brand on the gi. yes=have written OK; requested=asked, not yet granted; no=declined. Only consent=yes AND status=ok is print-ready — set yes ONLY when you actually hold written permission.

logo_url.description: New absolute https URL of the hi-res / vector logo.

note.description: Free note, e.g. 'vector requested from pr@…'.

name: mu_gi_logo_set
title: Update an ISAMI gi sponsor logo (owner only)
